note: P57.1 three-axis warning model. Axis 1 (clinical classification) is decided ONLY by P54 verified intervals or P57 Researcher-approved, server-attested, applicable criteria. Axis 2 (review priority) and axis 3 (data quality) never change axis 1. Rules marked EXISTING_BEHAVIOUR restate behaviour already present in the repository; rules marked PENDING_SCIENTIFIC_APPROVAL are proposals and are NOT applied unless a caller explicitly asks for a labelled preview. No rule converts units, infers fasting status, specimen, method, symptoms or demographics, or uses synthetic demonstration identities for classification.

rules.when: P57 classifyWithCriteria outcome == 'classified' (or P54 verified interval match)
catalog identity starts with 'demo:' or has no exact catalog unit
rules.then: NEUTRAL; criteria cannot be approved for it

rules.when: criterion not approved for this mission, or a mission-level / per-observation condition (fasting, specimen, method, symptoms) not recorded
rules.then: NEUTRAL with the missing condition named
The source's own band label (e.g., 'Mild hyperkalaemia (UKKA)', 'Prediabetes range (ADA Table 2.2)') is carried with the colour so source distinctions are preserved

rules.when: any P56.1 flag of kind 'priority_review' (P561-R1 change ≥50 %, P561-R2 intermediate peak/trough ≥50 % vs first and last, P561-R3 electrolyte change ≥10 %)
rules.note: Relabels the existing 'Review flag'. The underlying percentages are themselves PENDING_SCIENTIFIC_REVIEW in data/scientific/p56-review-priority-rules.v1.json.

reviewPriority.precedence: HIGH > ROUTINE > NO_FLAG; the highest applicable level wins.

meaning.VERIFIED: Provenance checks passed (exact non-demo catalog identity, exact catalog unit, specimen and method recorded, numeric value, no data-quality flag). It does NOT mean clinically validated.
meaning.DATA_QUALITY_WARNING: A concrete reason to doubt the measurement exists; interpret only after verification.
meaning.UNKNOWN: Information needed to judge data quality is missing.

rules.when: P561-R4 slow-marker change (e.g., HbA1c ≥10 % in <28 days)
recorded value is not a plain number
repeated readings at one examination differ (ExamPoint.repeat == 'differing_repeats')
catalog identity is a synthetic demonstration entry (demo:)
catalog unit missing or not identical to the recorded unit

independence: Review priority and data quality never set, raise or lower the clinical classification.

A HIGH review priority may be drawn in red ONLY with the flag glyph and the words 'High review priority — not a clinical classification'; clinical RED is a filled red badge with the approved criterion's band label.
Pending rules are evaluated only in an explicitly labelled 'Proposed rules preview' and never in live reports.

legend.text: Clinical RED — meets a Researcher-approved criterion band labelled by its source (not a diagnosis).
Clinical AMBER — in an approved criterion's cautionary band.
Clinical NORMAL — within an approved criterion's normal band.
NEUTRAL — no approved criterion applies; the value is shown without colour.
High review priority — not a clinical classification. Change-based triage for Ground Medical review.
Routine review — not a clinical classification.
Data-quality warning — verify sample identity, method and entry before interpretation.
Data quality unknown — specimen, method or exact identity not recorded.
